K0c TURBULENT RUNG -- CONTROL PREDICTIONS, REGISTERED BEFORE ANY CONTROL RESULT
===============================================================================
F14 cooling ladder, gate K0c Section 2.  Nothing below was written after a
control result was read.  This whole file is reproduced verbatim into
gate_k0ct.json so the prediction and the outcome travel together.

KIND definitions, carried unchanged from the laminar rung:
  REACHABILITY -- the FAIL branch of this check is reachable at all; the band is
                  not decorative.
  RECOGNITION  -- the check tells a physically wrong answer from a right one, at
                  the magnitude the gate cares about.
  SENSITIVITY  -- not a control.  A measured difference used to attribute a
                  deviation to a cause.  It cannot pass or fail.

AND THE TRAP THIS RUNG INHERITS: KV1b passed while proving nothing, because a
uniform field made its planted sum identically zero.  Every control below is
therefore stated with the thing that would make it vacuous, and that thing is
checked.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C1 -- TURBULENCE OFF.  KIND: RECOGNITION.
Case C1_hi_c_laminar: exact twin of T_hi_c with constant/turbulenceProperties
set to `simulationType laminar` and nothing else changed.

PREDICTION.  Without a turbulence model the cavity runs a laminar
boundary-layer regime whose core is strongly and stably stratified.  The
laminar rung of this same gate measured core stratification S between +0.5187
(Ra 1e3) and +1.0368 (Ra 1e5) on the square cavity, by the same definition
(K0c_RESULTS.md, "Core stratification -- MEASURED, UNGRADED").  Predicted here:

    S_C1  >=  0.30      -- at least 3x the reference 0.095, at least 4x outside
                           the gate's 0.05 band
    gate verdict on the S row for this case: FAIL

WHAT WOULD MAKE IT VACUOUS: if the graded kOmegaSST case ALSO produces S >= 0.30,
C1 distinguishes nothing, because both answers would be the laminarised one.
That is checked and reported either way.
IN-LOG WITNESS OF THE PLANT: the running solver prints "Selecting turbulence
model type laminar" and performs ZERO k or omega solves.  A plant living only in
a dictionary would leave the k/omega solve lines in the log.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C2 -- RAYLEIGH NUMBER RAISED 30 PERCENT.  KIND: RECOGNITION AT THE GATE'S OWN SCALE.
Case C2_hi_c_Ra130: exact twin of T_hi_c with dT (hence Ra) multiplied by 1.30.

THE PREDICTION IS DERIVED FROM THE REFERENCE'S OWN TWO-Ra PAIR, BEFORE THE RUN,
and from nothing this rung produced.  Spec Section 2.3 gives the mid-height peak
mean velocities at both Rayleigh numbers:

    up-peak    +0.140 m/s at Ra 0.86e6   ->  +0.190 m/s at Ra 1.43e6
    down-peak  -0.135 m/s at Ra 0.86e6   ->  -0.189 m/s at Ra 1.43e6

so V_peak ~ Ra^n with
    n_up = ln(0.190/0.140) / ln(1.43/0.86) = 0.6004
    n_dn = ln(0.189/0.135) / ln(1.43/0.86) = 0.6615

A 30 percent rise in Ra therefore gives 1.30^n:

    PREDICTED shift in peak |V| against this case's own coarse twin:
        +17.4 percent to +19.4 percent
    which EXCEEDS the gate's 15 percent band on the velocity rows.
    gate verdict on the velocity rows for this case: FAIL

THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING CONTROL.  A 15 percent band that could not see a 30
percent error in the driving parameter would make the rung's pass mean nothing.
IN-LOG WITNESS OF THE PLANT: the hotT and coldT function objects make the
RUNNING SOLVER print its own wall temperatures every 50 iterations.  Their
difference must read 51.87 K against the graded case's 39.90 K, a ratio of
exactly 1.300.  A plant living only in 0.orig/T would not move those lines.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C3 -- COMPARATOR MUTATION.  KIND: REACHABILITY of every band, one at a time.
No compute.

PREDICTION: perturbing each solved value in turn by 1.5x its own band, in the
direction AWAY from the reference, flips THAT row and only that row to FAIL.
    every_row_reachable = True
C1 and C2 show that SOME rows can fail.  They say nothing about whether the
other rows are wired to pass.  This is that check.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C4 -- TURBULENCE SEED RAISED 100x.  KIND: RECOGNITION OF A CONFOUND.
Case S_hi_c_seed100: exact twin of T_hi_c with the initial k multiplied by 100
(and omega seeded consistently from the same mixing length).

A RANS solve of a weakly turbulent buoyant cavity can be seed-determined: too
low a seed relaminarises, too high a seed leaves an eddy viscosity that never
decays.  Either way the "answer" would be an initial condition.

PREDICTION: the converged answer does not move by a tenth of its own band.
    |S_seed100 - S_baseline|            <= 0.005      (a tenth of the 0.05 band)
    |V_peak_seed100/V_peak_baseline - 1| <= 1.5 percent (a tenth of the 15 percent band)
If either moves more, the answer is seed-determined and the graded rows are
REFUSED, not graded.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
B -- END-WALL BOUNDARY CONDITION.  KIND: SENSITIVITY (not a control).
Case B_hi_c_adiabatic: the two measured rubber-wall temperature profiles are
replaced by zeroGradient.

REGISTERED IN ADVANCE: S moves by more than 0.02, the data's own resolvable
increment on S.  The purpose is to put a MEASURED number on the boundary
condition's leverage, so the attribution rule below is quantitative.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
M -- TURBULENCE MODEL.  KIND: SENSITIVITY (not a control).
Case M_hi_f_LS: exact twin of T_hi_f with RASModel LaunderSharmaKE instead of
kOmegaSST, differing in constant/turbulenceProperties and the k/epsilon vs
k/omega field pair and in nothing else.

NO VALUE IS PREDICTED.  What is registered before the run is the rule below.

===============================================================================
THE ATTRIBUTION RULE, REGISTERED BEFORE ANY RESULT IS READ
===============================================================================
A deviation from the reference could be the mesh, the model, the boundary
conditions, or the reference's own uncertainty.  A rung that cannot tell them
apart has not validated anything.  So, for each graded quantity q:

    D_mesh  = |q(fine)          - q(coarse)|          same case
    D_model = |q(kOmegaSST)     - q(LaunderSharmaKE)| fine mesh, hi Ra
    D_bc    = |q(measured ends) - q(adiabatic ends)|  coarse mesh, hi Ra
    U_ref   = the reference's OWN increment: 0.02 on S (its fit residual), and
              3.6 percent on the velocity peaks (its measured antisymmetry defect)
    E       = |q(solve) - q(reference)|

  1. E <= U_ref                      -> agreement.  Nothing to attribute.
  2. E > U_ref, and one of D_mesh, D_model, D_bc is within a factor of 2 of E
                                     -> that one is the prime suspect, named.
  3. E > U_ref and ALL of D_mesh, D_model, D_bc are below E/2
                                     -> none of the three explains it.  The
                                        deviation is charged to what is COMMON
                                        to every case: the model CLASS, or the
                                        case setup.

AND ONE DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION, WHICH IS FALSIFIABLE AND IS REGISTERED NOW.
OpenFOAM's INCOMPRESSIBLE RAS models carry NO buoyancy production or destruction
term in the k equation.  (`buoyantKEpsilon` exists only in the COMPRESSIBLE
family -- src/TurbulenceModels/compressible/RAS/buoyantKEpsilon -- and cannot be
selected by buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam, which constructs an
incompressible::turbulenceModel.  Verified by reading the installed source, not
recalled.)  In a STABLY stratified core that term is a SINK: G_b = -beta g.grad(T)
nut/Prt < 0.  Omitting a sink over-predicts core turbulence, over-mixes the core,
and therefore biases the core stratification S LOW.

    IF S comes out BELOW 0.095 in BOTH models by a similar amount, the missing
    buoyancy sink is the prime suspect and the model twin CANNOT separate it,
    because both models are missing the same term.
    IF S comes out ABOVE 0.095, the missing sink is EXONERATED and the cause is
    elsewhere.

===============================================================================
CONVERGENCE, REGISTERED BEFORE THE RUN
===============================================================================
Standing criterion, docs/physics_rules.yaml thermal block: PEAK-TO-PEAK SPREAD
of the graded quantity over a FIXED window of 400 outer iterations sampled every
50 (9 samples, the block's own minimum).  Not residuals.  Not an endpoint
difference.  Not a fraction of the run.

Applied here to THREE quantities, ALL of which must pass:
  (a) Nu_avg on the hot wall  -- p-p spread < 0.02 percent  (the standing number)
  (b) core stratification S   -- p-p spread < 0.001 absolute (the S band 0.05
      divided by 50, which is the same 1/50 rule the standing number itself was
      derived by, applied to the quantity this gate actually grades)
  (c) peak |Uy| in the domain -- p-p spread < 0.02 percent

A case failing any of the three is REFUSED and not graded.  The criterion is not
loosened and no averaging scheme is invented.  If a graded case cannot be
converged, that is reported as the result.

cost_proposal:
K0c TURBULENT RUNG -- COMPUTE COST ESTIMATE, WRITTEN BEFORE ANY GRADED RUN
==========================================================================
Registered 2026-08-18. F14 cooling ladder, gate K0c Section 2.
Authorization: up to 150 core-minutes of a 300 core-minute overnight thermal
ceiling, 100 of which two other rungs are already drawing.

THE BASIS IS MEASURED, NOT RECALLED
-----------------------------------
Two scratch pilots were run in the session scratchpad, OUTSIDE the case tree,
before this estimate was written.  Both are charged below.  Machine: AMD EPYC
9R14, single-core solves throughout, so core-minutes = wall clock.

  mesh          cells    iterations   solver ExecutionTime   s/iteration   s/(cell.iteration)
  40 x 120       4800       300            2.65 s            8.83e-03        1.84e-06
  64 x 192      12288       300            6.39 s            2.13e-02        1.73e-06

The two rates agree to 6 percent per cell, which is the check that the number
is a rate and not an artefact of one mesh.

CONTINGENCY ON THE RATE: 1.6x.  The pilots are 300 iterations into a developing
flow, where p_rgh converged in 3 PCG sweeps.  A developed buoyant field takes
more, and the rate is therefore an underestimate of the steady-state rate by an
amount this factor covers.  It is a stated multiplier, not a hidden one.

ITERATION COUNTS, and why they are what they are: the laminar rung of this same
gate needed 3000 iterations at Ra 1e3 and 12000 at Ra 1e6 on a 192x192 mesh,
and every one of its fine meshes had to be CONTINUED because an under-relaxed
SIMPLE outer loop moves the smooth modes at a rate falling off like 1/N^2.
This cavity is 28.7 aspect ratios tall, so its slowest mode is longer still.
20000 outer iterations are budgeted on every coarse mesh and 30000 on every
fine mesh, which is roughly 2.5x the laminar rung's worst case.

THE ESTIMATE
------------
  coarse case: 20000 x 8.83e-03 s x 1.6 =  282.6 s =  4.71 core-minutes
  fine case:   30000 x 2.13e-02 s x 1.6 = 1022.4 s = 17.04 core-minutes

  6 coarse cases (T_lo_c, T_hi_c, C1, C2, B, S)          28.3 core-minutes
  3 fine cases   (T_lo_f, T_hi_f, M_hi_f_LS)             51.1 core-minutes
  pilots already spent (3.58 s + 7.61 s wall)             0.19 core-minutes
                                                        --------------------
  first pass                                             79.6 core-minutes
  continuation reserve, one further stage at half length
    on any case that misses the convergence criterion
    (the laminar rung needed this on every fine mesh)     40.0 core-minutes
                                                        --------------------
  TOTAL PROPOSED                                        119.6 core-minutes

  AUTHORIZED CEILING                                    150   core-minutes
  HARD STOP                                             140   core-minutes

STOP RULE.  If the running total reaches 140 core-minutes, the remaining cases
are abandoned and the rung reports what it has, with the unrun cases named.  A
reduced run is not silently relabelled as the rung.

WHAT WOULD BLOW THIS ESTIMATE, NAMED IN ADVANCE
-----------------------------------------------
1. The case does not reach steady state.  Betts and Bokhari's own authors could
   not converge a steady solution on a related case and used transient
   averaging.  If a graded case here cannot meet the convergence criterion, the
   row is REPORTED AS REFUSED with its measured spread.  A transient leg is
   NOT run inside this authorization: at the same mesh a transient solve needing
   physical averaging over even 30 convective transits (H/V = 11.5 s each) is
   several hundred core-minutes, which is more than the whole ceiling.  It is
   proposed, not executed.
2. LaunderSharmaKE is a low-Reynolds-number k-epsilon with exponential damping
   functions and is stiffer than kOmegaSST.  If it needs a second stage it is
   the most likely single consumer of the continuation reserve.
